name: Utsugi
source:
"Compared to this beautiful starry sky, how small an existence I must be..."

A gardener serving the Aster family. Silent and deeply devout. Originally a rough person, he was saved by the Aster Faith and became a gardener.

[Translated from [url=https://www.primula.jpn.com/qualiadelta/chara01.html]the official website[/url].]
